shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清两件装的内容与配色组合，赢下点击

shots.intent: 让买家代入日常单穿场景，看清贴身垂坠与肩带宽度

把组合里的两种配色并排摆清，帮买家确认到手内容再决定
以最后一套叠穿收口，留出干净的行动位推动组合下单

style.backgroundSystem: seamless paper studio backdrop only: pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and structure callouts, warm oat beige #E9DBCC and off-white #F8F3EC for on-body and scene shots; no outdoor or room sets
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line marks only, one accent colour, used as blank label slots; no filled or 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: warm high-key studio light, large softbox front-left key with a broad bounce fill, soft directional falloff and a shadow that falls to the right on the backdrop; skimming light only for rib relief
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimal apparel-basics visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm oat beige #E9DBCC, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one camel accent #C08A52; warm high-key studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key, broad bounce fill and a soft shadow falling to the right; seamless paper backdrop as the only environment, matte white board for flat lays; modern geometric sans-serif for callouts with hairline leader rules; thin single-weight line icons in blank label slots; garments worn or laid flat true to shape, on-body framing cropped from the collarbone down; stable product scale and centre-left placement with clean copy space on the right; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no identifiable model faces or source wordmarks
style.presentationRules: on-body styling always cropped from the collarbone down so no face is identifiable; garments laid flat true-to-shape with straps aligned; consistent scale and centre-left placement with clean copy space on the right
style.surfaceSystem: flat seamless backdrop as ground for on-body shots; matte white board for flat lays; no wood, no fabric tabletop styling
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for callouts only, charcoal #2D2D2D, one headline plus a short stacked label list, hairline leader rules; no serif, no script
